caption: The drawing depicts a clamp-like object, which appears to be a sewing clamp with a pincushion attached on top. The pincushion is oval, covered in a green fabric, and secured with metal pins or tacks along one side. The main body of the clamp is painted blue and decorated with white floral and bird motifs, including leaves, flowers, dots, and a bird on one side. A round, tan-colored wooden or painted circle is positioned in the center of the clamp's vertical face. At the bottom of the clamp, a wooden screw with a rounded, turned handle allows the clamp to be fastened to a surface. The background is plain, and the overall composition centers the object on the page. The artist's name, “GRACE L. HALPIN,” is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Table Pin Cushion
